name: Bounty Hunter
description: Trackers, investigators and negotiators who bring in marks for pay — operating at the edge of law and criminal society.

modifiers.description: DM+2 if last term was in Agent or Rogue career

tech_ops.name: Tech Ops
tech_ops.description: You run support from a hideout, safe house or base of operations.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: You are the one in the field who is sent after marks.

fixer.name: Fixer
fixer.description: You are responsible for finding and negotiating contracts.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as result 2 on the Injury Table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury Table and take the lower result. Lose REP -1.
mishaps.2: A criminal you have successfully tracked down offers you a deal to allow them to go. If you accept, you cannot claim the bounty and lose REP -1 but gain Cr50,000. If you refuse, you make an Enemy of your mark as well as D3 of their friends and allies.
mishaps.3: In the process of investigating your mark, you discover the person who hired you is equally complicit in the crime. Roll Broker, Diplomat or Persuade 8+. If you succeed, you make a deal that absolves you of the need to fulfil your contract while allowing your client to save face or avoid legal consequences. If you fail, your mark takes the fall and you become known as unreliable. Lose REP -1.
mishaps.4: You accept a contract that later goes against your moral code and you cannot complete it in good conscience. Gain an Enemy and lose REP -1.
mishaps.5: Your efforts to find a mark attract the attention of their associates and they injure you in an ambush. Roll on the Injury Table and lose REP -1.
mishaps.6: Something goes terribly wrong during pursuit of a mark and you must either suffer a hit to your reputation or engage with the worst elements of the criminal underworld to succeed. Choose between losing REP -1 or owing MCr1 (with 20% interest accruing every year once you muster out and start adventuring) to a crime lord.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table.
events.3: You chase a high profile bounty but another bounty hunter is already on the trail. Roll Investigate 8+. If you fail, roll on the Mishaps table. If you succeed, gain REP +1 and increase one of these skills by one level: Athletics, Deception, Gun Combat, Investigate, Persuade, Stealth or Streetwise. Either way, the bounty hunter becomes a Rival.
events.4: You successfully complete a difficult bounty and are well rewarded for your efforts. Gain REP +1 and DM+1 to one Benefit roll.
events.5: Your network of contacts grows. Gain D3 Contacts.
events.6: You receive advanced training, formal or otherwise. Roll INT 8+ to increase any one of the following skills you already possess by one level: Engineer, Explosives, Gunner, Pilot, Survival or Vacc Suit. If you do not have any of these skills, pick one and receive it at level 1.
events.7: Life event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You develop a new understanding in the use of ranged weaponry. Gain one level in Gun Combat or Heavy Weapons.
events.9: You accept a bounty to bring in a corrupt politician. Roll Investigate 8+ or Streetwise 8+. If you succeed, gain REP +1 and DM+1 to one Benefit roll. If you fail, roll on the Mishaps table and gain an Enemy.
events.10: You pull out all the stops to bring in a mark. Gain REP +2.
events.11: You work with a more accomplished bounty hunter. Gain REP +1 and count them as an Ally.
events.12: You bring in an infamous criminal, who is well-known for the notorious crimes they committed. Gain REP +2 and roll twice on the Benefits table.

8.benefit: Free Trader, Safari Ship or Yacht
